name: Hattingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Hattingen (Saint George on horseback slaying the dragon on blue).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident Arnsberg of 10 July 1970 the city was granted the right to bear arms, a banner and a flag; the hoisted flag is divided blue and yellow with the city arms at the centre, the banner parted vertically.

features.role: Hattingen arms — Saint George on blue
